embeds.title: 🕰️ incident report — the duel clock was wrong
embeds.description:
**Heads up: tonight's duel time moves earlier.** The first two nightly rounds fired ~66 minutes late (19:06/19:07 UTC instead of the planned 18:00) and missed the evening window entirely — no standings posted until we forced one through by hand tonight.

**what happened**
The round was scheduled for the top of the hour, 18:00 UTC exactly — which, as an internal review lasting exactly as long as it took to read GitHub's own scheduling docs revealed, is the single most congested minute on all of GitHub Actions. Blame lands on **Nigel Batchley**, scheduling clerk, who set it there because "round numbers look tidier on the form" and refused to consider any minute that wasn't a multiple of ten. Shown the incident graph, he remains unconvinced.

**what changed**
• the round now scores at **17:53 UTC** (≈ 19:53 CEST / 18:53 CET) — *before* the advertised 20:00/19:00 slot, not after
• scoring early rather than late is deliberate, not just a congestion dodge: locking the board ahead of the advertised hour means there's no grace window to camp and dump fresh scrap into your board right before the snapshot — this is an idle game, not a reflex check
• the off-the-hour minute also dodges the queueing delay that ate the first two nights

Nigel's form has been amended to permit minutes ending in 3. He is furious about it.

footer.text: we ride at dawn · nightly PvP league
